cmd_skills_col_bundled: Column header of `atlas skills status`: the version bundled in this atlas binary. Printed in capitals, bold.
cmd_skills_col_description: Column header of `atlas skills list`: what the skill does. Printed in capitals, bold.
cmd_skills_col_installed: Column header of `atlas skills status`: the version installed on disk. Printed in capitals, bold.
cmd_skills_col_name: Column header of `atlas skills list`: the skill name. Printed in capitals, bold.
cmd_skills_col_skill: Column header of `atlas skills status`: the skill name. Printed in capitals, bold. A skill is a bundled instruction package for coding agents.
cmd_skills_col_version: Column header of `atlas skills list`: the version of the skill. Printed in capitals, bold.
cmd_skills_install_hint: Last line of `atlas skills list`. {command} is the command to run (`atlas skills install`), printed in bold.
cmd_skills_installed: Status of one skill in `atlas skills install` when it was written for the first time. {version} is the skill version. A glyph and the skill name come before it.
cmd_skills_installed_total: Summary line of `atlas skills install`: how many skills were installed for the first time. {count} is the number, {dir} the folder they were written to. i18n-allow pt-zero: only printed under `if installed > 0` (crates/atlas-cli/src/commands/skills/install.rs).
cmd_skills_list_total: Summary line of `atlas skills list`. {count} is the number of skills in this binary, {version} the atlas version.
cmd_skills_nothing_changed: Summary line of `atlas skills install` and `update` when every skill already matched the bundled copy. {dir} is the skills folder.
cmd_skills_outdated_count: Yellow warning at the end of `atlas skills status`: how many installed skills differ from the bundled copy. A hint to run the update command follows. i18n-allow pt-zero: only printed under `if outdated > 0` (crates/atlas-cli/src/commands/skills/status.rs).
cmd_skills_status_total: Summary line of `atlas skills status`. {present} skills of {total} bundled are installed in the folder {dir}.
cmd_skills_up_to_date: Status of one skill in `atlas skills install` when its files already match the bundled copy. {version} is the skill version.
cmd_skills_update_hint: End of the warning line of `atlas skills status`, after the count of outdated skills. {command} is the command to run (`atlas skills update`), printed in bold.
cmd_skills_updated: Status of one skill in `atlas skills install` when an older copy was rewritten. {version} is the new skill version. A glyph and the skill name come before it.
cmd_skills_updated_total: Summary line of `atlas skills install` and `update`: how many installed skills were rewritten with the bundled copy. {count} is the number, {dir} the folder. i18n-allow pt-zero: only printed under `if updated > 0` (crates/atlas-cli/src/commands/skills/install.rs).
